sheet: Nothing about your temperament is unusual; on every trait you fall where most people fall. In how kind, courteous and trusting you are, you are typical. In how orderly, industrious and reliable you are, you are typical. In how calm you are, and how often you get worried or low, you are typical. In how outgoing, assertive and energetic you are, you are typical. In how curious, imaginative and receptive to new ideas you are, you are typical.
appraisal: It is a normal working week as far as you are concerned: some strain, nothing special, and you will wait and see how the assistant fares.
